pages.title: Harrington's Mountain Goat
pages.text: Harrington's mountain goat ($(o)Oreamnos harringtoni$()) was a smaller relative of the living mountain goat that lived in western North America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)Its remains have been found in caves in the Grand Canyon, along with preserved dung and hair.$(br2)Like its living relative, it probably had a shaggy white coat and short black horns.
